text: DeepSeek Harness Forge Plugins 是面向 DSH 的工具插件组合，包含计算验证、经验记忆、TCM 诊断和会话证据审计。它通过 bundle 注册四个插件，并向 agent 提供数学化简、逻辑与正则验证、SPARQL 查询、gate 链式调用、代码运行与工作区文件工具，还可检索 BM25 经验、查看折叠记忆、诊断状态和查询药对。evidence-first 会记录工具结果并检查完成类声明。适合希望在 DSH 中扩展开发辅助与记忆能力的用户；需要配置 gate 可执行文件，并为药对检索准备数据文件。

DeepSeek Harness Forge Plugins adds math, logic, regex and chained gates to DSH, plus code and workspace tools. It recalls BM25 memories, opens folded notes, diagnoses TCM patterns, searches herb pairs, and audits claims against tool events. Configure gate binaries and provide formula data.

DeepSeek Harness Forge Plugins 的功能「数学与规则验证」：用户可调用工具化简或求解表达式、检查逻辑命题，并验证正则对正负样例的完整匹配结果。
DeepSeek Harness Forge Plugins 的功能「组合 gate 步骤」：用户提交 stages 与停止策略后，插件按顺序编排多个计算或知识查询 gate，并返回逐步结果。
DeepSeek Harness Forge Plugins 的功能「经验记忆检索」：用户输入当前任务描述后，插件对记忆条目执行 BM25 排序并返回相关片段，同时标记内容新鲜度。
DeepSeek Harness Forge Plugins 的功能「状态诊断与药对检索」：用户可提交文字或八维向量获取状态诊断，也可输入两味药检索同时包含它们的方剂。
DeepSeek Harness Forge Plugins 的功能「会话证据核对」：用户调用审计工具后，插件扫描会话中的声明与工具执行事件，汇总无相邻工具证据的声明。

deepseek-harness-forge-plugins README · ⚒️ Forge Plugins for DeepSeek Harness：**13 production-grade tools · 4 plugins · zero npm dependencies · pure Cordis** — the fastest way to give your DeepSeek Harness agent a *real* compute brain: symbolic math, formal logic, theorem proving, regex verification, model checking, code repair, TCM diagnosis, and memory recall.

---

deepseek-harness-forge-plugins README · ✨ Why Forge Plugins?：| | |
|---|---|
| 🧮 **Real computation** | Symbolic math and logic that never hallucinate — every tool runs a compiled gate binary and returns **verified** results |
| 🧠 **Formal reasoning** | TPTP first-order theorem proving (EPROVER) + state-machine model checking, not just text generation |
| 🀄 **TCM diagnosis** | Unique 八极八势 (Eight Trigrams) pattern diagnosis and herb-pair retrieval across an ancient-formula corpus — **the only TCM plugin for DeepSeek Harness** |
| 🪶 **Zero deps** | Pure Cordis plugins, no npm install, no framework bootstrap code — drop-in and go |
| 🔒 **Sandboxed** | All file access goes through `ctx.fs` (host-plane discipline) — no bare `fs` calls |
| 🎁 **Prebuilt binaries** | Windows `.exe` included in [Releases](https://github.com/jinguanghai/deepseek-harness-forge-plugins/releases/latest) — Linux/macOS build from `src/go` in one command |

deepseek-harness-forge-plugins README · 🔌 Plugins and Tools：| Plugin | Tool | What it does | Example result |
|---|---|---|---|
| **forge-gates** | `forge_math` | Symbolic simplification / evaluation | `3*(x+1)-3*x` → **`3`** |
| | `forge_logic` | Formal proof / equivalence check | `x>0 and x<10 -> x>0` → **proved** |
| | `forge_regex` | Fullmatch regex validation | `[A-Z]\d{3}` vs `B456` → **pass** |
| | `forge_eprover` | TPTP first-order theorem proving | CNF axioms → **theorem / counter-sat** |
| | `forge_system` | State-machine model checking (deadlock/invariant) | 6 states → **passed** |
| | `forge_repair` | Code defect fix suggestions | bare `except:` → **`except Exception:`** |
| **forge-tcm** | `tcm_diagnose` | 八极八势 TCM pattern diagnosis | text/vector → trigram + strategy |
| | `tcm_herb_pair` | Herb-pair co-occurrence retrieval | 附子+干姜 → 916 formulas |
| **forge-memory** | `memory_recall` | BM25 experience recall | query → ranked snippets |
| | `memory_fold_list` | Folded-memory index (π/φ) | list folded sections |
| | `memory_fold_preview` | Preview a folded section | content preview |
| | `memory_fold_deep` | Deep-read a folded section | full content |

`agent.cordis.yml` snippet:

```yaml

deepseek-harness-forge-plugins README · inside your preset directory：plugins:
  - path: ./plugins/forge-gates
  - path: ./plugins/forge-tcm
  - path: ./plugins/forge-memory
  - path: ./plugins/evidence-first
```

Then just ask your agent:

> *"Simplify 3*(x+1)-3*x"* → `3` ✅
> *"Prove that x>0 follows from x>0 and x<10"* → `proved` ✅
> *"Check regex [A-Z]\d{3} against B456 and order B456 ok"* → pass/fail ✅
> *"附子 配 干姜 有哪些方剂?"* → ranked formulas from your corpus ✅

deepseek-harness-forge-plugins README · 🔧 Environment：| Variable | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `FORGE_GATE_BIN` | `<repo>/bin/windows` | gate binary dir (Linux/macOS: `go build` from `src/go`, see below) |
| `FORGE_HOME` | `process.cwd()` | memory data dir (`memory.json` / `.forge-temp/memory_current.json` / `data/memory_current.json`) |
| `FORGE_DATA` | cwd / `data/` | TCM formula dir (must contain `formula_db.json`) |

deepseek-harness-forge-plugins README · 🔨 Build Gates from Source (Linux / macOS / Windows)：```bash
cd src/go
for g in math logic regex eprover system repair tcm; do
  go build -o ${g}_gate${EXT} ${g}_gate.go
done   # Windows: set EXT=.exe

> 💡 Windows users: prebuilt `.exe` binaries are attached to the [v0.1.0 Release](https://github.com/jinguanghai/deepseek-harness-forge-plugins/releases/latest) — no build needed.

deepseek-harness-forge-plugins README · 📊 Data Notes：- **forge-tcm** herb-pair retrieval requires **`formula_db.json`** — a private ancient-formula corpus (家传古籍数据) that is **NOT distributed with this repo**. Provide your own and point `FORGE_DATA` at it.
- **forge-memory** reads `memory.json` / `.forge-temp/memory_current.json` / `data/memory_current.json` — bring your own memory files (empty templates in `data/`).
- The gates themselves are pure logic (no private data baked in).

---

deepseek-harness-forge-plugins README · 🎯 Project Lineage：Forge (铸剑炉) is a general-purpose digital agent: a multi-language compiler sandbox with **12 tool gates** (Python / Go / Node / Math / Logic / Regex / Knowledge / TCM / …), an LLM brain over a code body, and self-evolving architecture. This repo is its **dsh-native plugin family** — same gates, same discipline, now *Everything is a Plugin*.
